title: The Festival of the Second Shore
description: Once a year, villagers lower their finest rugs from the bridge. On the far side of the reflection, neighbors walk across the woven paths carrying reeds.
alt: Villagers hang crimson patterned rugs from a wooden bridge. The rugs stretch across black water as people carrying bundles of reeds walk along them.
pairing: Lakeside weaving festival × a world in the reflection
